name: FluxTimestepGuidanceProjectionEmbedding

timestep.description: timestep values (batch,), dtype float16/bfloat16; multiplied by 1000.0 for sinusoidal embedding

pooled_projections.description: pooled text projections (batch, dim), dtype float16/bfloat16

freqs.description: frequency values for sinusoidal positional embedding (inner_dim,), dtype float16/bfloat16

timestep_linear1_weight.description: first linear layer weight (time_embed_dim, inner_dim*2), dtype float16

timestep_linear1_bias.description: first linear layer bias (time_embed_dim,), dtype float32

timestep_linear2_weight.description: second linear layer weight (time_embed_dim, time_embed_dim), dtype float16

timestep_linear2_bias.description: second linear layer bias (time_embed_dim,), dtype float32

text_embedder_weight.description: text embedder linear weight (time_embed_dim, pooled_dim), dtype float16

text_embedder_bias.description: text embedder linear bias (time_embed_dim,), dtype float32

reference:
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

def run(timestep: torch.Tensor, pooled_projections: torch.Tensor, freqs: torch.Tensor, timestep_linear1_weight: torch.Tensor, timestep_linear1_bias: torch.Tensor, timestep_linear2_weight: torch.Tensor, timestep_linear2_bias: torch.Tensor, text_embedder_weight: torch.Tensor, text_embedder_bias: torch.Tensor):
    batch_size = timestep.shape[0]
    t_emb = timestep.to(torch.float32) * 1000.0
    t_emb = t_emb.unsqueeze(-1) * freqs.to(torch.float32).unsqueeze(0)
    t_emb = torch.cat([torch.sin(t_emb), torch.cos(t_emb)], dim=-1)
    t_emb = F.linear(t_emb, timestep_linear1_weight.to(torch.float32), timestep_linear1_bias.to(torch.float32))
    t_emb = F.silu(t_emb)
    t_emb = F.linear(t_emb, timestep_linear2_weight.to(torch.float32), timestep_linear2_bias.to(torch.float32)).to(timestep_linear2_bias.dtype)
    text_emb = F.linear(pooled_projections.to(torch.float32), text_embedder_weight.to(torch.float32), text_embedder_bias.to(torch.float32)).to(text_embedder_bias.dtype)
    out_dtype = torch.result_type(t_emb, text_emb)
    conditioning = (t_emb.to(torch.float32) + text_emb.to(torch.float32)).to(out_dtype)
    return conditioning
description:
Model that performs Flux timestep guidance projection embedding computation.
Computes sinusoidal positional embedding for timestep, applies two linear layers with SiLU activation,
computes text embedding via linear projection, and combines both via addition.

Forward logic (fp32 precision):
    1. t_emb = timestep.to(fp32) * 1000.0
    2. t_emb = t_emb.unsqueeze(-1) * freqs.to(fp32).unsqueeze(0)
    3. t_emb = cat([sin(t_emb), cos(t_emb)], dim=-1)
    4. t_emb = linear(t_emb, timestep_linear1_weight, timestep_linear1_bias)  # fp32
    5. t_emb = silu(t_emb)  # fp32
    6. t_emb = linear(t_emb, timestep_linear2_weight, timestep_linear2_bias).to(bias_dtype)
    7. text_emb = linear(pooled_projections.to(fp32), text_embedder_weight, text_embedder_bias).to(bias_dtype)
    8. out_dtype = result_type(t_emb, text_emb)
    9. conditioning = (t_emb.to(fp32) + text_emb.to(fp32)).to(out_dtype)

Args:
    timestep (Tensor): Timestep values, shape [batch], dtype float16/bfloat16.
    pooled_projections (Tensor): Pooled text projections, shape [batch, dim], dtype float16/bfloat16.
    freqs (Tensor): Frequency values for sinusoidal embedding, shape [inner_dim], dtype float16/bfloat16.
    timestep_linear1_weight (Tensor): First linear weight, shape [time_embed_dim, inner_dim*2].
    timestep_linear1_bias (Tensor): First linear bias, shape [time_embed_dim], dtype float32.
    timestep_linear2_weight (Tensor): Second linear weight, shape [time_embed_dim, time_embed_dim].
    timestep_linear2_bias (Tensor): Second linear bias, shape [time_embed_dim], dtype float32.
    text_embedder_weight (Tensor): Text embedder weight, shape [time_embed_dim, pooled_dim].
    text_embedder_bias (Tensor): Text embedder bias, shape [time_embed_dim], dtype float32.

Returns:
    Tensor: Conditioning tensor, shape [batch, time_embed_dim].
